gauntlet.intent: roe-mid-mission-change (T5 theme recipe, tierMin 5, newly eligible): a multi-domain theater op where BLUE's air arm genuinely CHANGES ROE partway through the 40-tick run, not merely starts asymmetric like gauntlet-forge-20260727-1455-t2-c3 (orbat-asymmetric-ratio, static WeaponsTight-vs-WeaponsFree for the whole run) or gauntlet-20260727-1455-t3-s1 (whose asw-contact-roe/strike-contact-roe triggers are gated on basePd=1.0 detections that resolve at SimTick=0, so they fire immediately rather than mid-mission despite being nominally 'triggers'). Force mix: BLUE 9 units (4 surface FFG/corvette + 3 air [2 fighters f-16c-blk-52iq-falcon-2015/jas-39e-gripen-ng-2021, 1 ASW helo ka-27m-helix-a] + 2 subsurface [SSN, SSK]) vs RED 10 units, air-heavy per the tier's dense-red joint mix (3 surface + 5 air incl. su-57-felon fifth-gen + tu-160-blackjack strategic bomber + 2 subsurface). BLUE starts side-wide WeaponsTight; RED is WeaponsFree throughout. All BLUE units except f-16c/jas-39e stay WeaponsTight for the entire run (static asymmetry, as in t2-c3/t3-s1) -- the NOVEL part is that f-16c-blk-52iq-falcon-2015 and jas-39e-gripen-ng-2021 alone escalate to WeaponsFree via mission.triggers['dca-su57-detect-roe-escalation'] partway through, once f-16c's own detection trial against su-57-felon (contact c-t5c3-7) actually transitions Unknown->Detected -- the same real, engine-consumed mechanism confirmed working in t3/t4 (an existing detection[] contact's state change fires the trigger; no contacts[].appearAtTick scripted appearance is used or relied on, consistent with BUG-scenario-contacts-shadowed-by-detection.md's finding that contacts[] is silently dead whenever detection[] is non-empty, true here). The su-57-felon trial is deliberately given a LOW effective Pd (basePd 0.25 x envMask 0.5 = 0.125, vs 1.0/0.8/0.75 for every other detection entry in this file) so the Unknown->Detected transition is a genuine seed-dependent stochastic event spread across the 40-tick window (expected first-success around tick ~7-8 at Pd=0.125, per-tick independent Bernoulli roll in DeterministicDetectionLoop.RollTick) rather than resolving at tick 0-2 the way every other prior-tier ROE trigger in this corpus has. This is the first candidate in the corpus to intentionally engineer detection-timing variance specifically so the ROE change lands mid-run instead of at mission start; the exact tick is not scripted and will differ by seed (42/7/123) -- confirming the actual per-seed fire tick requires a real batch run, hence expect below is provisional. IMPORTANT CONFIRMED SCHEMA CAVEAT (found while drafting, not previously flagged in this corpus): MissionContactTargetClass (src/ProjectAegis.Sim/Scenario/MissionContactTargetClass.cs) only defines Any/Surface/Air, and Classify() treats every targetId as Surface UNLESS it literally starts with the string 'ucav' (Air requires that literal prefix -- it is NOT domain-aware). ScenarioPolicyJsonLoader.ParseMissionContactTargetClass silently falls back to Any via a failed Enum.TryParse for any unrecognized string. This means the 'Subsurface' targetClass used by t3-s1's asw-contact-roe trigger AND by the sibling candidate gauntlet-forge-20260727-1455-t5-c2's reinforcement-pressure-roe-escalation trigger never actually gates on subsurface-ness at all -- it silently parses to Any (matches every target) and both those triggers have been firing on ANY qualifying Unknown->Detected transition from their observer, not specifically a subsurface one. This candidate deliberately uses targetClass:'Surface' for the su-57-felon (an aircraft) trigger -- NOT 'Air', which would silently NEVER match since su-57-felon does not start with 'ucav' and would repeat the exact class of silent-gap failure documented in BUG-scenario-contacts-shadowed-by-detection.md. 'Surface' was chosen here specifically because it is the classifier's true 'matches everything non-ucav' branch, not because su-57-felon is a surface unit. Downstream consequence probed: jas-39e-gripen-ng-2021 already carries a live pd=1.0 fire-control track on su-35s-flanker-m-2023 (contact c-t5c3-4) from tick 0, but cannot engage it while WeaponsTight -- a real observed-but-refused engagement (same denial pattern as t2-c3), accumulating denials for however many ticks precede the trigger. Once the trigger fires, both f-16c and jas-39e escalate to WeaponsFree and should be able to start converting held/future tracks (including f-16c's own su-57-felon track, the same contact that caused the escalation) into probabilistic kills for the remainder of the run -- testing whether the oracle/scoring correctly reflects a genuine two-phase per-unit ROE regime within a single scenario, not just a static asymmetric baseline. This candidate has NOT been executed in a real batch run.
gauntlet.oracle: EXPECTED, NOT YET CONFIRMED (no batch execution performed for this candidate). Fingerprint must be non-empty and contain CATALOG_UNIT:<id>:surface / :air / :subsurface tokens for all 19 units (BLUE+RED, all three domains). A ContactChange Unknown->Detected entry for contact c-t5c3-7 (observer f-16c-blk-52iq-falcon-2015, target su-57-felon) is expected at some SimTick > 0 (seed-dependent, driven by the deliberately low 0.125 effective Pd -- NOT guaranteed at tick 0/1, and not guaranteed to occur at all within 40 ticks for every seed, since Pd=0.125 per-tick gives roughly an 18% chance the contact is still undetected after 15 ticks). When/if that transition occurs, a PolicyUpdate/MissionTransition pair keyed on trigger id 'dca-su57-detect-roe-escalation' / missionCode 'DCA' is expected, applying WeaponsFree to exactly f-16c-blk-52iq-falcon-2015 and jas-39e-gripen-ng-2021 (all other 7 BLUE units remain WeaponsTight for the full run). Prior to that tick, expect WEAPONSTIGHT-coded denials attributable to jas-39e's live track on su-35s-flanker-m-2023 (c-t5c3-4); after that tick, expect the possibility of BLUE air-domain kills from f-16c (vs su-57-felon) and/or jas-39e (vs su-35s-flanker-m-2023) that would not have been possible under the side-default WeaponsTight. If the su-57-felon detection never resolves within the 40-tick budget for a given seed, expect that seed to look identical to a static-WeaponsTight-for-BLUE-air run (denial-dominated, no BLUE air kills) -- this is the single largest source of expected cross-seed variance and must be confirmed by execution, not assumed.
